items.title: A functorial acyclic replacement killing a prescribed set of complexes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs functorially, for a prescribed set of acyclic complexes, a replacement of an arbitrary complex by one receiving a termwise injective quasi-isomorphism whose terms factor through injective subobjects and from which the prescribed complexes are homotopic to zero (statement lines 1921-1934). The proof is a complete construction: the replacement is assembled from products of functorial injective embeddings of the terms and the prescribed complexes (proof lines 1936-1948); functoriality, injectivity of the comparison map and the factorisation through injective subobjects are read off the construction (proof lines 1949-1953); and the cokernel is identified as a direct sum of acyclic complexes, which makes the comparison map a quasi-isomorphism (proof lines 1954-1956). The non-formal content is the assembly and the cokernel computation. The claim is H2.
